title: 第25章 新玩家第26章 来自新人的才艺展示上
lines: 两天时间转瞬即逝。
静室内，姜望缓缓收回按在阵盘上的双手，停止了灵力的输送。
连续两日不间断地温养阵法阵旗阵盘。
对他自身吸收灵气的进度造成了不小的影响，经脉间传来一丝细微的空乏感。
然而效果也是显着的。
那原本晦暗无光，如同蒙尘废铁般的阵盘与阵旗，此刻表面隐隐透出一丝内敛的光泽，触手也不再是冰冷的死物感，而是带上了一丝温润。
虽然距离完全激活尚需时日，但进展肉眼可见，成功就在眼前。
就在他正准备调息片刻时。
外面却是传来了一阵不同于往日的喧哗，并夹杂着难以抑制的惊呼和带着陌生口音的询问。
姜望心念一动，知晓是那三位新招募的玩家降临了。
他整理了一下衣袍，神色恢复平日的淡然，举步走出了静室。
仙门广场中央，赤红色的出生点水晶塔光华尚未完全敛去，塔旁已然多了三道身影。
爱吃菠萝的猫，是一个看起来二十多岁的年轻男生。
正瞪大了眼睛，不可思议地抓着自己的灰色布衣衣角揉搓，又狠狠掐了一下自己的胳膊，疼得龇牙咧嘴。
大锤十八，人如其ID，身材高大壮实，国字脸，浓眉大眼，他正用力跺着脚，感受着脚下传来的坚实触感，眼神发亮。
傲雪凌霜，一名气质文静，眼神却透着灵动的女生。
她没有像另外两人那样动作夸张，只是静静地站在那里，微微仰头看着湛蓝如洗的天空和远处苍茫的群山轮廓，手指无意识地绞着衣角，显示出内心的极不平静。
“卧槽……居然是真的……”
爱吃菠萝的猫喃喃自语，声音带着颤抖，既有初临异世界的惶恐，更有梦想成真般的巨大狂喜。
“这空气……这触感……”
傲雪凌霜深深吸了一口气，林间带着草木清香和泥土气息的空气涌入肺腑，那种鲜活的感觉，绝非一般虚拟设备能够模拟。
大锤十八则活动了一下手脚，脸上露出惊奇之色：“明明外貌没变，但这身体……比我自己那身肥肉得劲多了！”
“哈哈，醒醒神，别傻站着了！”
莽穿地球大笑着走上前，拍了拍离他最近的大锤十八的肩膀，那结实的触感让他很是满意：
“怎么样，没骗你们吧？是不是百分百真实？”
琉璃仙梦也笑着招呼道：“欢迎来到《修仙OL》，我是琉璃仙梦，他是莽穿地球，那边是剑斩红尘。”
她指了指刚从一间未完工的建筑里走出来的剑斩红尘。
剑斩红尘笑吟吟看着的三名新玩家，脸上带着一种过来人的理解和促狭。
只是当他习惯性地问起三人的开局属性。
并得知爱吃菠萝的猫和傲雪凌霜的体魄、根骨都在1.3到1.4之间。
大锤十八更是达到了1.5和1.6时，他脸上的笑容瞬间僵硬了几分。
“不是吧……新人开局属性都这么高的吗？”
剑斩红尘心里有点小酸，他可是辛辛苦苦干了这么久，喝了灵泉才把属性勉强拉到平均线的1.0啊。
这意味着，三名新人理论上只要喝上一两天清灵泉，就可以直接开始修炼《莽牛劲》武功秘籍了。
果然是，欧皇无处不在，非酋永不言败……
就在这时，一道平静却带着无形威严的声音响起，打破了新人们的兴奋交流。
content_en:
Two days passed in a blink of an eye.
In the quiet room, Jiang Wang slowly withdrew his hands from the formation plate and stopped the transmission of spiritual power.
For two consecutive days, we warmed and maintained the flag array of the array without interruption.
It had a considerable impact on his own progress in absorbing spiritual energy, and there was a slight sense of emptiness in his meridians.
However, the effect is also significant.
The formation disk and formation flag, which were originally dark and dull, like dusty scrap metal, now have a subtle sheen on their surface, and the tentacles no longer feel cold and dead, but have a touch of warmth.
Although it will take some time to fully activate, the progress is visible to the naked eye and success is just around the corner.
Just when he was about to adjust his breath for a moment.
There was a noise outside that was different from the past, mixed with uncontrollable exclamations and questions with unfamiliar accents.
With a thought in his mind, Jiang Wang knew that the three newly recruited players had arrived.
He adjusted his robes, his expression returned to his usual calmness, and he walked out of the quiet room.
In the center of the Immortal Gate Square, the crimson birth point crystal tower's brilliance has not completely faded away, and there are already three more figures beside the tower.
The cat who loves to eat pineapples is a young boy who looks to be in his twenties.
Zheng's eyes widened, he grabbed the corners of his gray cloth and rubbed it in disbelief, then pinched his arm hard, grinning in pain.
Sledgehammer eighteen, he is as tall and strong as his ID, with a Chinese character face, thick eyebrows and big eyes. He is stamping his feet hard, feeling the solid touch from under his feet, and his eyes are bright.
Aoxue Lingshuang, a girl with a quiet temperament but smart eyes.
She didn't make any exaggerated movements like the other two, she just stood there quietly, raising her head slightly and looking at the blue sky and the outline of the distant mountains. Her fingers unconsciously twisted the corners of her clothes, showing that she was extremely uneasy in her heart.
"Damn it...it's actually true..."
The pineapple-loving cat murmured to himself, his voice trembling, expressing both the fear of entering a different world for the first time and the great ecstasy of a dream coming true.
"This air...this touch..."
Aoxue Lingshuang took a deep breath, and the air with the fragrance of vegetation and earth in the forest poured into her lungs. That kind of vivid feeling could not be simulated by ordinary virtual devices.
Sledgehammer Shiba moved his hands and feet, with a look of surprise on his face: "Obviously the appearance has not changed, but this body... is much fatter than my own body!"
"Haha, wake up, stop standing there stupidly!"
Mangchuan Earth laughed and walked forward, patting the shoulder of Sledgehammer Shiba who was closest to him. The solid touch made him very satisfied:
"How about it? I didn't lie to you, did I? Is it 100% true?"
Liuli Xianmeng also greeted with a smile: "Welcome to "Xiuxian OL", I am Liuli Xianmeng, he is the man who crosses the earth, and over there is the sword cutting through the world."
She pointed at Jian Zhan Hongchen, who had just walked out of an unfinished building.
Jian Zhan Hongchen looked at the three new players with a smile, with a look of understanding and narrow-mindedness on their faces.
Just when he habitually asked about the starting attributes of the three people.
And I learned that the pineapple-loving cat and Aoxue Lingshuang's physiques and bones are between 1.3 and 1.4.
When Sledgehammer 18 reached 1.5 and 1.6, the smile on his face instantly stiffened a bit.
"Isn't that right... Do all newcomers start with such high attributes?"
Jian Zhan Hongchen felt a little bit sour. He had worked so hard for so long, and it was only after drinking the spirit spring that his attributes could barely reach the average of 1.0.
This means that in theory, the three newcomers only need to drink Qingling Spring for a day or two before they can directly start practicing the "Mang Niu Jin" martial arts secrets.
Sure enough, European emperors are everywhere, and non-chiefs never give up...
At this moment, a calm yet majestic voice sounded, breaking the excited exchanges between the newcomers.
